[Hive action] Commit — action 642597e8-217b-4bef-92fb-878d7b8cbfe5, attempt 1

Commit the work in your checkout now. Stage only the changes that belong to your current task, write a clear commit message, and create exactly one commit (if there is nothing to commit, report the current HEAD as commitSha).

When you are done, report the outcome with the hive CLI. Finishing your turn does NOT complete this action; only the report does:
  hive action report 642597e8-217b-4bef-92fb-878d7b8cbfe5 --attempt 1 --token dd9a89a4450ce8b3b9c3 --succeeded --output commitSha=<commitSha>
  hive action report 642597e8-217b-4bef-92fb-878d7b8cbfe5 --attempt 1 --token dd9a89a4450ce8b3b9c3 --failed --detail "<why>"
  hive action report 642597e8-217b-4bef-92fb-878d7b8cbfe5 --attempt 1 --token dd9a89a4450ce8b3b9c3 --ask "<question for the operator>"    (holds the queue until answered; the answer arrives as mail)
  hive action report 642597e8-217b-4bef-92fb-878d7b8cbfe5 --attempt 1 --token dd9a89a4450ce8b3b9c3 --progress "<short status>"

Outputs:
- commitSha (required): Full sha of the commit that was created (or the existing HEAD when nothing needed committing).
- branch: Branch the commit is on.
